title.narrative: Ukraina: Stöd för kraft, el och värmeproduktion, Energy Community
Ukraine: Support to power, electricity and heat production, Energy Community

description.narrative: Det övergripande målet med insatsen är att tillhandahålla stabil och tillförlitlig funktion av Ukrainas energisystem, särskilt i regioner som påverkas av det pågående kriget. Genom att tillhandahålla oavbrutna leveranser av elektricitet och värme kommer insatsen att stödja kritisk infrastruktur, såsom sjukvårdsinrättningar, skolor och allmännyttiga tjänster, för att säkerställa fortsatt drift av nödvändiga tjänster såsom vattenförsörjning och sanitet.

The overall objective of the operation is to ensure the stable and reliable functioning of Ukraine's energy system, especially in regions affected by the ongoing war. By providing uninterrupted supplies of electricity and heat, the operation will support critical infrastructure, such as healthcare facilities, schools and public utilities, to continue operating essential services such as water supply and sanitation.

The overall objective of the project of the construction of the CHP plant is to ensure the stable and reliable functioning of Ukraines energy system, particularly in regions severely affected by the ongoing war. By providing uninterrupted electricity and heating services, the project will support critical infrastructure, such as health care facilities, schools, and public utilities, ensuring the continued operation of essential services like water supply and sanitation. Stable energy supply is essential for the well-being of the population and the resilience of the countrys economy and public services during both the conflict and the post-war recovery period.
The specific objective of the Swedish support to the fund with this project is to provide financial and technical support for the procurement of two gas turbines essential for the first phase of construction and operation of the CHP plant, ensuring that it can deliver stable, reliable electricity. When complemented with the combined cycle in phase two of the project, the plants combined heat and power capabilities will enhance energy efficiency by utilizing the waste heat from electricity generation to provide both industrial process- and district heating, thus maximizing resource utilization and minimizing emissions.

7.1 - Senast 2030 säkerställa allmän tillgång till ekonomiskt överkomliga, tillförlitliga och moderna energitjänster.
